note: Kneehill County campground along the northeast shore of Keiver's Lake, 1 mile south of Highway 583 on Range Road 26-0, with well-treed lots, walking trails, a playing field, ball diamond, basketball court, horseshoe pits and a central playground. The shoreline sites face the lake across the campground road. The lake is not stocked, motorized boats are not allowed and swimming is not recommended. --Claude
